# Fishing Scent Holder

![Render](render.png)

## Description
This is a parametric 3D model designed to make it easy to place fishing scent bottles securely in a boat, gear box, or lure box so they do not flip over and make a mess. Keep your fishing gear clean and organized.

## Try it out
To modify the model or print an STL/3MF file, you can view this live in the OpenSCAD playground by following this link:
[OpenSCAD Playground](https://ochafik.com/openscad2/#)
